context_for_next_testing_agent: The alerts.tsx page was completely rewritten from scratch in this session. All functionality working correctly for all user roles. Key verified features: 1) En cours/Cloturees tabs with accurate counts, 2) Active alert detail with red background, beneficiary card, intervention card showing STRUCTURE NAME (not individual intervenants list), slide action buttons inside scroll content, 3) Resolved alert detail with green background, no action buttons, resolution section, timeline/chronologie, 4) Comprendre les alertes explainer page opens/closes correctly, 5) Admin/Teleassistance roles have 'Lancer Care Watch' and 'Cloturer' operator buttons, 6) Guardian role has slide buttons for intervenir/cloturer.
